name: codex-token-observer
description: A local Codex token observatory backed by app-server usage events and rollout history.

interface.shortDescription: Watch Codex context and token usage in a live local window.
interface.longDescription: A privacy-first local dashboard for Codex. It reads official app-server token usage and local rollout JSONL files to show current context, output tokens per second, cache tokens, today's usage, usage since the active rate-limit reset window, and a model breakdown.
defaultPrompt: Show my current Codex context and token usage.
Explain where the token usage numbers come from.
